classification.difficultyReason: Part c requires forming and solving a Pythagorean equation with x on both a leg and the hypotenuse, including correctly squaring 2x. Part b also requires adding a radius and connecting equal chords with perpendicular symmetry.

content.prompt: Find the value of x in each triangle. Round your answers to 1 d.p.

spec.description: Isosceles triangle with base x, equal sloping sides, left side 43 cm, dashed altitude and an external 38 cm height dimension.
spec.mathematics: Equal sides imply that the altitude bisects the base. Half the base is sqrt(43^2-38^2).
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown x are visible.

answer.worked:
The altitude bisects the base of the isosceles triangle.
$$\begin{align*}
\frac{x}{2}&=\sqrt{43^2-38^2}\\
\frac{x}{2}&=\sqrt{405}\\
x&=2\sqrt{405}\\
x&\approx40.2\text{ cm}
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Circle with horizontal diameter, centre dot and an isosceles triangle in the upper semicircle. Left sloping side x; equal-side ticks; lower-right radius arrow labelled 26.
spec.mathematics: Both the half-diameter and the apex-to-centre radius are 26. Thus x=sqrt(26^2+26^2).
spec.answerVisibility: No supplied answer, added altitude or right-angle marker is visible. Radius and answer remain unitless.

answer.worked:
Join the apex to the centre. The equal sloping sides make this radius perpendicular to the diameter. Both shorter sides of the resulting right-angled triangle are radii of length 26.
$$\begin{align*}
x&=\sqrt{26^2+26^2}\\
x&=\sqrt{1352}\\
x&\approx36.8
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Upright equilateral triangle with single ticks on all three sides. Right side labelled 2x; dashed altitude labelled 96 mm; each half of the base labelled x.
spec.mathematics: The altitude bisects the base and forms a right-angled triangle with hypotenuse 2x and shorter sides x and 96 mm. Hence 3x^2=96^2.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknowns are visible; no right-angle square is added.

answer.worked:
Use either right-angled triangle formed by the altitude.
$$\begin{align*}
96^2+x^2&=(2x)^2\\
9216+x^2&=4x^2\\
3x^2&=9216\\
x^2&=3072\\
x&=\sqrt{3072}\\
x&\approx55.4\text{ mm}
\end{align*}$$
